notes.title: 1.0.0.6 is released.
notes.content:
1.0.0.6 is released for both the full game and demo.

Improvement: Modified tutorial sessions to use pictures to explain.

Bug fixed:
1) When virus is dead or revived, near by processes will update their colors, to reflects door module's range is modified from virus's dead/revive.

2) when gathering from command "go ... and gather and go ...", move virus away using "go" command, will no longer crush the game.
